title: Nautlius Tweaks
description: this datapack tweaks the Nautilus by making them more resistant to trident damage and removing the underwater mining speed penalty
body:
This is a datapack that modifies the Nautilus by making them more resistant to trident damage and removing the underwater mining speed penalty while you're on them! These only apply once you ride a nautilus

This pack can be uninstalled using /function nautli_tweaks:uninstall
